description: Danfoss Performer scroll and Maneurop reciprocating compressors for package units, chillers and commercial cooling.

series.name: Performer SM scroll
series.description: Danfoss Performer scroll compressors for R22 systems, widely used in package units and chillers. The model number is the nominal capacity in thousands of BTU/h (SM120 ≈ 10 TR).
power_supply: Other voltage codes available on some models
features: Can be fitted in tandem or trio sets for larger systems
Common in package units and air-cooled chillers

series.name: Performer SH scroll
series.description: Danfoss Performer scroll compressors for R410A systems, from package units up to large chillers. The model number is the nominal capacity in thousands of BTU/h.
power_supply: Other voltage codes available on some models
features: Can be fitted in tandem or trio sets for larger systems
Uses POE oil, as required for HFC refrigerants
Common in rooftop units, package units and chillers

series.name: Maneurop MTZ reciprocating
series.application: Medium and high temperature: cold rooms, chillers and commercial cooling
series.description: Danfoss Maneurop MTZ reciprocating compressors for commercial refrigeration and air conditioning. Capacity depends heavily on refrigerant and operating temperatures, so we size them from your unit's existing model.
features: Robust design for medium and high temperature duty
Used in cold rooms, water chillers and commercial cooling
